'''Seff Hellin''' was a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served during the [[Time/Legends|time]] period following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. He had been a student at the [[Jedi Praxeum|Jedi Academy]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] and was approximately fourteen when it was evacuated during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|war]] with the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. He wore his hair in a curly style.

Hellin was one of the first [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the [[New Jedi Order]] to develop the [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-related [[Force psychosis|psychosis]] that came upon [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in [[43 ABY]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
Seff Hellin was born around [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]]<ref name="Age" /> to a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] mother.<ref name="Millennium Falcon" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] Seff Hellin along with the other Jedi [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Younglings]] were sent to [[Shelter]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]], with him being noted to be the eldest of the group. It was during this time that the being [[Abeloth]] contacted the younglings and put the madness in him that would come when he was older. The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] wouldn't know about this until years later.
He went on to train as a Jedi.

By [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]] he was a full Jedi Knight.

===Later life===
Hellin rescued [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Solo family/Legends|his family]] when [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana]] was kidnapped on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. These actions involved killing or maiming several members of an arms syndicate based on [[Denon/Legends|Denon]]. Because he had no authority to act on Taris, Seff was ordered by [[Galactic Alliance Intelligence Service|Galactic Alliance Intelligence]] agents to surrender his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. He was told by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] to do so and that she would call [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] on his behalf, but Seff refused, stating that Skywalker "didn't understand."

He then disarmed and temporarily paralyzed the intelligence agents attempting to take him into custody with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and fled the room at incredible speed. This led Leia to comment that he should not have been able to do that, meaning his abilities had progressed beyond what was normal. Seff was then declared a rogue Jedi, refusing to submit to the authority of the Masters by returning to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

His actions on Taris caused even further distrust of the Jedi on the part of [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]], which led her to dispatch a team of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] to bring him into custody. As a result of this, Luke Skywalker was forced to recall all of the Jedi to the [[New Jedi Temple|Temple]] at Coruscant until further notice, as well as try to reassure Daala that the Jedi were self-policing and that Mandalorians should not be involved.

It was known that Seff was extremely distrustful of Daala's intentions towards the Jedi and the Mandalorians involvement in [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] affairs, so much so that, a month or two before the events on Taris, he approached [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]&mdash;without the authority or knowledge of the [[New Jedi Order]]&mdash;about [[Tendrando Arms]] producing a Mandalorian Hunter Droid similar to the [[YVH-Series battle droid|YVH]] class of [[Droid/Legends|droids]].

After hearing of Valin Horn's [[Force psychosis|mental state]], Seff came to believe that he and Valin were the only ones who had not been replaced by impostors. Seff spent weeks planning to rescue Valin from [[Armand Isard Correctional Facility|the prison]] where he was being held encased in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]. During [[Raid on the Armand Isard Correctional Facility|his rescue attempt]], Seff was captured by a group of conspirators known as [[Darkmeld]] led by [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Jagged Fel]]. Seff was sedated and secretly brought back to the [[Jedi Temple detention center#Asylum Block|Asylum Block]] in the Jedi Temple where Master [[Cilghal]] and Jedi Knight [[Tekli]] tried to ascertain the nature of his mania.

When Chief Daala attempted to gain possession of all psychotic Jedi, the Solos smuggled them out of the Temple, and took them to the [[Jedi Academy (Shedu Maad)|academy]] on [[Shedu Maad]].

In [[44 ABY]], Hellin and the other Jedi suffering from the mysterious Force psychosis snapped out of their delusions in the aftermath of Luke Skywalker's [[Mission to the Maw|first battle]] with [[Abeloth]] on [[Abeloth's planet]]. They were brought from Shedu Maad to the Jedi Temple by [[Zekk]] and Tekli. Hellin participated in the [[Raid on Detention Center 81|rescue]] of Jysella and [[Valin Horn]] as a member of "Team Saav'etu." Disguised as exterminators, the team used foam coating to mask the cam bubbles of the [[Galactic Alliance Security Detention Center 81|facility]] and then breached the outer walls with [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]].

Inside, the team discovered thousands of prisoners frozen in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] alongside the Horn siblings. During the raid, Hellin provided security for his team's escape and managed to destroy one of two [[Galactic Alliance Security]] troopsleds.
